basis: Purchasing corroboration and catalogue specifications; no verified PR-to-AM receipt links. Opening stock dates excluded.

entries.reason: AM names T120S. Supplier quote specifies T120SBK, 278 × 8 mm; UGP requires 200 × 4.8 mm.

entries.reason: AM model TTD151 is corroborated by a quote for TTD151F, main 25–95 / tap 6–35 mm².
entries.check: RET must clarify whether UGP 16–35 mm² refers to the main or tap conductor and verify both ranges.

entries.reason: AM model TTD201 also appears in the quotation, rated 25–95 / 25–95 mm².
entries.check: Check both conductor ranges: 16 mm² is outside the quoted minimum.

entries.reason: AM M16 × 1.5 m matches the UGP diameter and length.
entries.check: Confirm solid copper construction; dimensions alone do not establish material.

entries.reason: AM rod is 1.2 m; UGP requires 1.5 m.
entries.check: Find the 1.5 m variant and confirm solid copper construction.

entries.reason: A supplier quote identifies an M16 earth spike clamp; AM has a generic earth spike clamp entry.

entries.reason: AM pigtail bolt is M16 × 380 mm; UGP requires 200 mm length.

entries.reason: AM CB44 model is corroborated by a supplier quote for CB-44 box with slide lid.

entries.reason: AM explicitly describes a galvanized steel stay thimble, consistent with the UGP description.
entries.check: Confirm the 16 mm size suits the specified stay assembly and that the current UGP reference has no additional constraints.
